question: How should one daily offer aśvamāra flowers to achieve the stated ritual effect?
premises: Aśvamāra flowers are used as the oblation material.
The flowers are smeared with honey.
The offering is performed every day.
inference: One who daily offers aśvamāra flowers smeared with honey performs the prescribed oblation.
uncertainties: The identity of the aśvamāra plant is not specified.
plain_english: One who smears aśvamāra flowers with honey and offers them every day performs this oblation.
